clips.title: The story
paras: At the Whelgar's Excavation site, Merrin Rockweaver sends an urgent message from the Wetlands. Raptors have overrun the dig, but Merrin assures her loved ones that she survived.

Merrin Rockweaver writes from the ruined dig at Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands. The dwarven expedition had been uncovering enormous prehistoric fossils and relics when they disturbed a nest of Mottled Raptors. The beasts swarmed the trenches, killed several workers, and cut off the surviving researchers. Amid the chaos, Merrin sends word to her husband Tarrel at Menethil Harbor. She, Prospector Whelgar, and Ormer Ironbraid survived behind a barricaded shelter.
